description: Shows the signed-in person what a booking change would do, and changes nothing. For type cancel it lists which parts of the booking can be canceled and on what terms (refund, fees); for rebook or modify it says what would be passed to the trip's concierge. Show the result to the person. If they agree, call cancel_booking (cancel) or request_booking_change (rebook or modify) with the same reference. The preview is saved as a note in the person's Autonomad thread; no booking is changed and nothing is passed on. It does not check whether the trip has Trip Concierge. Needs the connection signed in to an Autonomad account, with the bookings:cancel permission (asked for the first time it is used).

component_ids.description: Only these parts of the booking (ids from preview_booking_change). Omit for all.

details.description: rebook / modify: what the person wants changed, in their words (required). cancel: optional note. Up to 4000 characters.

reference.description: The booking reference the person was given (e.g. ANM-1A2B3C4D), or the trip id.

type.description: What the person wants: cancel the booking, rebook it, or modify it.

name: preview_booking_change
